# GECCO Workshop on Real-Parameter Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB 2013)

The forth GECCO Workshop on Real-Parameter
Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB 2013) took place
during GECCO 2013 in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.


## Previous Web Page
You can find the previous webpage for this workshop at the 
[Internet Archive](https://web.archive.org/web/20200924124434/https://coco.gforge.inria.fr/doku.php?id=bbob-2013).
